name: It's a Secret to Everybody
label: Quest
description: It's a Secret to Everybody: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Grabbing onto it, you pull the pack back to the shore. Perhaps if you examine the items inside the pack, you might find out more about who it belongs to.
There are a few stray travelers at Marshal's Refuge. Perhaps you might find out more there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hi there. I've seen you before... Haven't I?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh... Yes, these things do look familiar... Well, kind of...
